entities.summary: Siaosi ʻAlipate Halakilangi Tau’alupeoko Vaea Tupou, Baron Vaea of Houma, was a Tongan politician and noble who served as Prime Minister of Tonga from 1991 to 2000. Vaea was a nephew of Queen Sālote Tupou III and the father of the current Queen of Tonga, Nanasipauʻu Tukuʻaho.
